newsitem.title: USA: Niagara Mohawk plant returns to full power.
newsitem.headline: Niagara Mohawk plant returns to full power.

text.p: Niagara Mohawk Power Corp's 610 megawatt (MW) Nine Mile Point nuclear power unit 1 has returned to full power following a brief weekend repair outage, a company spokesman said Monday.
"The plant returned to service on Sunday, we are currently operating at full power," said spokesman Alberto Bianchetti.
The Scriba, N.Y., unit was shut Friday to fix a leak in the plant's drywell. The drywell collects drainage inside the primary containment area, where the unit's reactor is located.
Niagara Mohawk operates and is the sole owner of Nine Mile Point unit 1.
